name: AIC Inc.
summary: Headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, AIC Inc. is a global technology provider that specializes in server and storage solutions, serving clients across the United States, Asia, and Europe. The company offers a comprehensive range of products, including custom Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Original Design Manufacturer (ODM) services, as well as commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) offerings. Its diverse portfolio encompasses various server types, such as rackmount, multi-node, GPU-accelerated, and network security servers. For data storage, AIC provides solutions like Just a Bunch Of Disks (JBOD), Just a Bunch Of Flash (JBOF), high-availability systems, and advanced all-flash NVMe servers. Additionally, they manufacture industrial PCs, server chassis, and critical accessories like canisters and front bezels. AIC also delivers specialized design services, focusing on maximizing input/output capabilities, and supplies systems built on AMD EPYC processors. These versatile solutions are tailored for numerous applications, including cloud computing, data centers, network infrastructure, media and entertainment, industrial automation, video surveillance, and VMware-ready environments. Established in 1996, the company operated under the name T-win Systems, Inc. before officially rebranding as AIC Inc. in June 2011.
